mapper.select:
SELECT xm.XM_OID AS id, mo.MO_OID AS rmaNumber,
(SELECT VALUE FROM BASIL_ODS_PRD.SUPPORT_ATTRIBUTE_VALUES WHERE SAV_OID = xm.status) as status,
xm.RECEIVED_DATE as receivedDate, (SELECT MAX(QA_QC_DATE) from BASIL_ODS_PRD.XREF_QA xq where xq.XM_OID = xm.XM_OID) as quarantineDate, xm.SCHEDULED_DATE as scheduledDate, part.PART_NUMBER_LONG as partNumber, msn.SERIAL_NUMBER as serialNumber, part.VERSION_NUMBER as versionNumber,
part2.PART_NUMBER_LONG as partNumber2, msn2.SERIAL_NUMBER as serialNumber, part2.VERSION_NUMBER as versionNumber2,
xm.REPAIR_DATE as completedDate, (SELECT VALUE FROM BASIL_ODS_PRD.SUPPORT_ATTRIBUTE_VALUES WHERE SAV_OID = xm.CUSTOMER_REPORTED_ISSUE) as customerReportedIssue, (SELECT VALUE FROM BASIL_ODS_PRD.SUPPORT_ATTRIBUTE_VALUES WHERE SAV_OID = xm.ESD_KIT) as esdKit, (SELECT VALUE FROM BASIL_ODS_PRD.SUPPORT_ATTRIBUTE_VALUES WHERE SAV_OID = xm.PHYSICAL_DAMAGE_PRESENT) as physicalDamagePresent, (SELECT VALUE FROM BASIL_ODS_PRD.SUPPORT_ATTRIBUTE_VALUES WHERE SAV_OID = xm.CUSTOMER_ISSUE_REPRODUCED) as customerIssueReproduced, xm.CUSTOMER_REPORTED_ISSUE_EXT as reportedIssueExt, xm.TAMPER_LOG_INTERPRETATION as tamperLog, (SELECT VALUE FROM BASIL_ODS_PRD.SUPPORT_ATTRIBUTE_VALUES WHERE SAV_OID = xm.ERROR_MESSAGE) as errorMessage, (SELECT VALUE FROM BASIL_ODS_PRD.SUPPORT_ATTRIBUTE_VALUES WHERE SAV_OID = xm.BATTERY_VOLTAGE) as batteryVoltage, xm.REPAIR_DATE as repairDate, (SELECT VALUE FROM BASIL_ODS_PRD.SUPPORT_ATTRIBUTE_VALUES WHERE SAV_OID = xm.DEPARTMENT) as department, (SELECT TRACKING_NUMBER FROM BASIL_ODS_PRD.XREF_SHIP xs WHERE xs.BOX_OID = xm.BOX_OID) as trackingNumber, (SELECT CUSTOMER_ORGANIZATION FROM BASIL_ODS_PRD.MASTER_CUSTOMER mc WHERE mc.MC_OID = mo.MC_OID) as customerName,
emp.NAME as assignee, xm.TECH_NOTES as techNotes,
msn.WARRANTY_END_DATE as warrantyEndDate, msn.WARRANTY_VOIDED_DATE as warrantyVoidedDate, DATE(mo.ORDER_DATE) as orderDate, (SELECT SHIP_DATE FROM BASIL_ODS_PRD.XREF_SHIP xs WHERE xs.BOX_OID = xm.BOX_OID) as shipDate
FROM MASTER_ORDER mo INNER JOIN XREF_MATERIALS xm ON xm.MO_OID = mo.MO_OID INNER JOIN MASTER_SERIAL_NUMBER msn ON msn.MSN_OID = xm.MSN_OID INNER JOIN MASTER_PART part ON part.PART_OID = msn.PART_OID LEFT JOIN XREF_TECHNICIAN xt ON xt.XT_OID = xm.TECHNICIAN LEFT JOIN EMPLOYEE_MASTER emp ON emp.EMP_OID = xt.EMP_OID LEFT JOIN MASTER_SERIAL_NUMBER msn2 ON msn2.MSN_OID = xm.MSN_OID2 LEFT JOIN MASTER_PART part2 ON part2.PART_OID = msn2.PART_OID
xm.XM_OID = #{id}

select sn.SERIAL_NUMBER as serialNumber, xma.MSN_OID as msnOID, xma.CUSTOMER_RMA as customerRMA,xma.CUSTOMER_TERMINAL_ID as customerTerminalID, xma.CUSTOMER_REPORTED_ISSUE as customerReportedIssueExt, xma.XM_OID as xmOID, xma. MO_OID as moOID from BASIL_SEC_PRD.PREP_XREF_MATERIALS as xma left join BASIL_ODS_PRD.MASTER_SERIAL_NUMBER as sn on sn.MSN_OID=xma.MSN_OID
xma.MO_OID = #{id}

select sn.SERIAL_NUMBER as serialNumber, xma.MSN_OID as msnOID, xma.CUSTOMER_RMA as customerRMA,xma.CUSTOMER_TERMINAL_ID as customerTerminalID, xma.CUSTOMER_REPORTED_ISSUE as customerReportedIssueExt, xma.XM_OID as xmOID, xma.MO_OID as moOID from BASIL_ODS_PRD.XREF_MATERIALS as xma left join BASIL_ODS_PRD.MASTER_SERIAL_NUMBER as sn on sn.MSN_OID=xma.MSN_OID
xma.MO_OID = #{id}

select res.MO_OID as moOID ,res.RESPONSE_DATE as responseDate,res.CONTENT as content, users.NAME as responseBy from BASIL_SEC_PRD.XREF_RESPONSE as res left join BASIL_SEC_PRD.USERS as users on users.U_OID=res.RESPONSE_BY
res.MO_OID = #{id}
SELECT scav.SCV_OID as id, scav.VALUE as department FROM BASIL_SEC_PRD.SUPPORT_CLIENT_ATTRIBUTE_VALUES scav WHERE scav.SC_OID = 2 ORDER BY scav.SORT_ORDER ASC
SELECT scav.SCV_OID as id, scav.VALUE as orderType FROM BASIL_SEC_PRD.SUPPORT_CLIENT_ATTRIBUTE_VALUES scav WHERE scav.SC_OID = 1 ORDER BY scav.SORT_ORDER ASC
SELECT scav.SCV_OID as id, scav.VALUE as status FROM BASIL_SEC_PRD.SUPPORT_CLIENT_ATTRIBUTE_VALUES scav WHERE scav.SC_OID = 3 ORDER BY scav.SORT_ORDER ASC
SELECT scav.SCV_OID as id, scav.VALUE as repairType FROM BASIL_SEC_PRD.SUPPORT_CLIENT_ATTRIBUTE_VALUES scav WHERE scav.SC_OID = 1 AND scav.DEPARTMENT=100 ORDER BY scav.SORT_ORDER ASC

SELECT msn.WARRANTY_END_DATE as warrantyExpDate, msn.WARRANTY_VOIDED_DATE as voidDate, msn.SERIAL_NUMBER as serialNumber FROM BASIL_ODS_PRD.MASTER_SERIAL_NUMBER as msn
msn.SERIAL_NUMBER = #{serialNumber}

SELECT msn.SERIAL_NUMBER as serialNumber FROM BASIL_ODS_PRD.MASTER_SERIAL_NUMBER msn JOIN BASIL_SEC_PRD.PREP_XREF_MATERIALS pxm ON msn.MSN_OID = pxm.MSN_OID
msn.SERIAL_NUMBER = #{serialNumber}
AND pxm.STATUS != 113
UNION
SELECT msn.SERIAL_NUMBER as serialNumber FROM BASIL_ODS_PRD.MASTER_SERIAL_NUMBER msn JOIN BASIL_ODS_PRD.XREF_MATERIALS xm ON msn.MSN_OID = xm.MSN_OID
msn.SERIAL_NUMBER = #{serialNumber}
AND xm.STATUS != 113

SELECT msn.SERIAL_NUMBER FROM BASIL_ODS_PRD.MASTER_SERIAL_NUMBER msn WHERE msn.SERIAL_NUMBER IN
#{item, jdbcType=INTEGER}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO BASIL_SEC_PRD.PREP_MASTER_ORDER (MC_OID, ORDER_STATUS, ORDER_DATE, ORDER_TYPE, RMA_NUMBER, SUBMITTER_ID) VALUES (#{mcOID}, #{orderStatus}, DATE_FORMAT(#{orderDate}, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s'), #{orderType}, #{rmaNumber}, #{submitterID})

INSERT INTO BASIL_SEC_PRD.PREP_XREF_MATERIALS (MO_OID, XM_OID, MSN_OID, CUSTOMER_RMA, CUSTOMER_TERMINAL_ID, CUSTOMER_REPORTED_ISSUE_EXT) VALUES
(#{item.moOID}, #{item.xmOID}, #{item.msnOID}, #{item.customerRMA},#{item.customerTerminalID},#{item.customerReportedIssueExt})

INSERT INTO BASIL_SEC_PRD.XREF_INBOUND_TRACKING (TRACKING_NUMBER, MO_OID)
SELECT #{item.num} AS TRACKING_NUMBER, #{item.moOID} AS MO_OID FROM BASIL_SEC_PRD.XREF_INBOUND_TRACKING WHERE NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM BASIL_SEC_PRD.XREF_INBOUND_TRACKING WHERE TRACKING_NUMBER = #{item.num} AND MO_OID = #{item.moOID} )
